purpose: Self-contained vendoring of Product OS (BuildBetter), an MIT-licensed evidence-first operating system for product work: 45 focused SKILL.md playbooks spanning discovery, strategy, delivery, operate and AI-product, plus six skillsets grouping them. Pure documentation; no upstream scripts/installers run; copied byte-for-byte.

source.fetchMethod: public read-only shallow git clone (--depth 1) to .tmp/upstream-skills/<repo>; HEAD resolved via git log. No write/push to upstream.

license.verified: Root LICENSE read and confirmed MIT; included verbatim.

projectRulesPriority.statement: Project AGENTS.md and its ADL decision-log entries are authoritative and override any vendored upstream skill guidance whenever they conflict.
upstreamSkillsDoNotGrant: writing DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or any credential into the repo
git push --force or rewriting already-pushed history
modifying user-home, global, IDE, or shell config
skipping the project independent-test gating or its GUI-evidence requirement
writing files via --persist (or equivalent) without explicit user authorization
projectRulesPriority.conflictResolution: Where a vendored playbook suggests behavior the project forbids (offline-first, keys-not-in-repo, no-force-push, data/ stays out of git), the project rules win and the playbook is reference only.
